A former captain from Spain, he developed designs with partner shipyards and expanded into brokerage and services. The company became publicly listed before financial difficulties led to its liquidation in 2014.

long_biography.plain_text:
French maritime entrepreneur Gérard Rodriguez grew up in Torrevieja in a family of seafarers, spending school holidays at sea with his father. He later captained the sailing yacht Waterbird and met wealthy customers through his work. Meeting his future wife prompted him to settle ashore: his captain's job had kept him away for half the year.

Personal contact remained part of his approach to customers. He travelled to meet Middle Eastern clients and discuss their preferences for interiors. As his company expanded, it acquired Camper & Nicholsons International, the business that had employed him as a young captain. His son Alexandre handled day-to-day management while Rodriguez concentrated on developing new designs.
